cells.gaps: Two figures for 2022/23 disagree: the higher education ministry's 2023-2024 yearbook gives 9.8 per cent of 31,503 graduates, Economia & Mercado reports about 11 per cent of 29,302; both are below 13.
cells.note: The ministry's own yearbook puts STEM graduates of 2022/23 at 9.8 per cent, below the 13 per cent line, and the press report of about 11 per cent agrees they are below it.
